import os, subprocess, time
t='/dev/cu.usbserial-1130'
if not os.path.exists(t):
    print('PRE_CAPTURE_SKIPPED target_missing'); raise SystemExit(0)
busy=subprocess.run(['lsof',t],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
if busy:
    print('PRE_CAPTURE_SKIPPED target_busy'); print(busy); raise SystemExit(0)
import serial
s=serial.Serial(); s.port=t; s.baudrate=115200; s.timeout=0.25; s.dtr=False; s.rts=False; s.open()
print('PRE_SERIAL_OPEN_OK',t)
start=time.monotonic(); lines=[]
while time.monotonic()-start < 45:
    raw=s.readline()
    if raw: lines.append((time.monotonic()-start,raw.decode('utf-8',errors='replace').rstrip()))
s.close()
print('PRE_TOTAL_LINES',len(lines))
print('PRE_ROM_BOOT_COUNT',sum('ESP-ROM:esp32s3' in x for _,x in lines))
print('PRE_RST_COUNT',sum('rst:0x' in x for _,x in lines))
print('PRE_PANIC_COUNT',sum(('Guru Meditation' in x or 'panic' in x.lower() or 'abort' in x.lower()) for _,x in lines))
print('PRE_BROWNOUT_COUNT',sum('brownout' in x.lower() for _,x in lines))
print('PRE_TIMELINE_BEGIN')
keys=('ESP-ROM:esp32s3','rst:0x','Guru Meditation','panic','abort','watchdog','wdt','brownout','Backtrace','firmware_sha','i2c probe','scd_','scd41','eink_display')
for dt,x in lines:
    if any(k.lower() in x.lower() for k in keys): print(f'{dt:07.2f}s | {x}')
print('PRE_TIMELINE_END')
